import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Load data
delays = pd.read_csv('deliveries.csv')
data_dict = pd.read_csv('data_dictionary.csv')

delays.replace(-1, pd.NA, inplace=True)

# Convert dates to datetime
filtered_delays['SHIP_DT'] = pd.to_datetime(filtered_delays['SHIP_DT'], format='%d/%m/%Y', errors='coerce')
filtered_delays['deliv_dt'] = pd.to_datetime(filtered_delays['deliv_dt'], format='%d/%m/%Y', errors='coerce')

# Calculate distances per year
years = filtered_delays['SHIP_DT'].dt.year.unique()
distances_per_year = []

    year_data = filtered_delays[filtered_delays['SHIP_DT'].dt.year == year]

    distances_per_year.append(total_distance)

# Find the largest and smallest distances
largest_distance = max(distances_per_year)
smallest_distance = min(distances_per_year)

# Difference between the largest and the smallest distances
difference = largest_distance - smallest_distance

# Round to the nearest integer
answer = round(difference)
